fluff.overview: The Manei Domini's Tau Zombie attack squads were among the most terrifying infantry formations fielded during the Jihad. Deployed in six-trooper squads rather than full platoons, each Zombie carried an extensive array of cybernetic enhancements: myomer-augmented muscles, prosthetic arms mounting built-in TK Enforcer weapons and magnetic grapples, multi-modal cybernetic eyes with infrared and laser targeting, full-body dermal armor reinforced by triple-strength myomer implants, and pain shunts that blocked all but the most catastrophic injuries. Armed with Mauser 1200 LSS laser rifles and heavy support lasers, Zombies fought with a mechanical relentlessness that unnerved even veteran soldiers. They never surrendered and never fled, continuing to fight through wounds that would incapacitate ordinary infantry. Surgically implanted suicide charges ensured that even a fallen Zombie remained dangerous, detonating when killed to inflict casualties on anyone nearby.
